stances.quote: Rep. Gallagher Votes to Pass the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 July 22, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. — Congressman James Gallagher (CA-01) today voted to pass the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (NDAA), legislation that strengthens America's military while delivering major investments for Beale Air Force Base and the servicemembers who defend our nation.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly supports NDAA passage to strengthen military with major investments, indicating pro-spending stance.
